title: CGST Act s. 9 — Levy and collection of CGST (CGST Act s. 9)

content.overview: Section 9 levies CGST on intra-State supplies of goods or services, other than alcoholic liquor for human consumption, on the value determined under section 15, and at the rates notified. The tax is paid by the taxable person. Reverse charge applies where the section or a notification says the recipient pays. The levy follows a taxable intra-State supply. The rate and the person who pays are separate from the fact of supply.

enhancement.statutoryFramework: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, section 9.
essentialIngredients: Goods or services other than excluded goods
Taxable person, or recipient on reverse charge
enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 9 is the charging section for CGST. Inter-State supply is IGST, not this levy. The provision also contains a reverse-charge limb and a tax on notified intra-State supplies by an electronic-commerce operator. Petroleum products are brought in only from a notified date. The rate is not written as a permanent number in this note.
examples: A dealer in one State sells goods to a consumer in the same State.
Section 9 is the CGST levy, with SGST beside it.
A sale to another State is an IGST question.
A notified reverse-charge service is paid by the recipient.
